<!-- pr-reviewer: 8dd7787b15eb94af6c9eeb6c8695d8f11595e505 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Gouge safety (the main question): the change only touches the region built by `stadium` (`crates/app/src/operation/material.rs:266`), and its only non-test caller is the Slot arm at `material_source.rs:200`. The generator is untouched. The cap polygon is now circumscribed: every chord is tangent to the true arc, so no point of the true arc lies outside the region (nothing legitimate is flagged), and corners stand at `h/cos(phi/2)`, at most `CAP_SAG_BUDGET` = 0.001 mm outside the arc. So the only slack added to a real over-cut is 1 um on top of the unchanged `GOUGE_TOL`. The first and last corner of each cap lie exactly on the side lines (perpendicular component `rc*cos(phi/2) = h`), so the straight sides stay exact. A real over-cut is still caught: `a_slot_driven_past_its_cap_is_still_a_gouge` shifts the path 0.05 mm and it is convicted.
- `cap_segments` is panic-free: non-finite or non-positive `h` falls back to the floor, `acos` input is clamped, the count is clamped to 16..2048 before the cast. No `unwrap`/`expect`/indexing added.
- Good pinning tests (`slot_caps.rs`), with a provenance header, a decision file, a `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #510`. No `CHANGELOG.md` edit, no dependency, `build.rs`, scripts or `.github` change.

**Local results (PR merged with current upstream/main, clean auto-merge)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` | builds |
| app lib | 101 passed |
| slot_caps | 4 passed |
| operations | 117 passed, 6 ignored |
| area_controls | 13 passed |
| cutting_data | 6 passed |
| project_roundtrip | 69 passed |
| golden_cl | 23 passed |
| verify | 21 passed, 2 ignored |
| blind_floor | 6 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The circular-op disk still uses inscribed chords (0.005 mm, under tolerance); agreed to leave it, as the PR says.
- The Top-Z air pass question is correctly split out as a separate issue.
- Not exercised here: release `--ignored` lanes, GUI outline drawing, real machine.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
